# ShortOpenTagUsage

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `ShortOpenTagUsageInspection`

The short open tag `<?` depends on the `short_open_tag` ini setting; code using
it breaks (prints source code) where that setting is off. Use `<?php`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{1,3,5,6} [Before]
<? $greeting = 'hi'; ?>
<p>
<? foreach ($users as $u) : ?>
  <b><?= $u ?></b>
<? endforeach ?>
<?
  while (next_row()) { ?><i>row</i><?php } ?>
</p>
<?php $done = true; ?>
```

```php [After fix]
<?php $greeting = 'hi'; ?>
<p>
<?php foreach ($users as $u) : ?>
  <b><?= $u ?></b>
<?php endforeach ?>
<?php
  while (next_row()) { ?><i>row</i><?php } ?>
</p>
<?php $done = true; ?>
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 1: Replace the short open tag &#39;&lt;?&#39; with &#39;&lt;?php&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Replace the short open tag &#39;&lt;?&#39; with &#39;&lt;?php&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Replace the short open tag &#39;&lt;?&#39; with &#39;&lt;?php&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Replace the short open tag &#39;&lt;?&#39; with &#39;&lt;?php&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ShortOpenTagUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ShortOpenTagUsage

/**
 * @noinspection ShortOpenTagUsageInspection
 */
```
